characterized_function: Astrocytes predominantly express TrkB.T1, and loss reduces morphological maturation and support of excitatory synaptogenesis.
The C1 cassette contains endoplasmic-reticulum retention motifs and changes surface trafficking of full-length GluN1 receptors.
The PSD-95 beta L27 domain binds CASK and Hrs; Hrs disruption selectively blocks beta synaptic clustering while sparing palmitoylated alpha.
Exon-15 exclusion changes polarized APP secretion and decreases beta-amyloid production relative to p3.
